observation: WWOX loss raises HIF1a, glycolysis, lowers respiration (cancer/MEF); HIF1 transactivates PDK1 which inactivates PDH (hypoxia cells)
relation_hypothesised: WWOX loss -> HIF1a -> PDK1 -> PDH-E1a(Ser293)-P -> lower PDH flux -> lactate (Model A)
context: Cancer cell lines, MEFs; hypoxic cells; never human neurons
benefit_to_verify: Reduced PDH flux and PDK-driven E1a phosphorylation in WWOX-null human neurons
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (non-neural); relation=inferred; neural PDH/PDK/E1a-P=not measured; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Each half published; Wwox-null mouse hypoglycemia consistent
unfavourable_or_alternative: Fly points to ATF4-LDH; neuron sign reversed; no human lactic acidosis; PDK1 switch cytoprotective
discriminating_experiment: Isogenic WWOX-null neurons: PDH activity, E1a Ser293-P, PDK1-4, 13C-pyruvate flux, DCA/PDK knockdown arm
reasoning_pattern: A mechanism established in tumour cells is joined with a second-system link through a shared node (HIF1a) and carried to neurons untested

observation: Drosophila Wwox knockdown (Abeta42 background): raised Ldh and lactate via Atf4; Ldh reduction rescues locomotion
relation_hypothesised: Wwox loss -> ATF4 -> LDH -> lactate, with pyruvate diverted to lactate not blocked oxidation (Model B)
benefit_to_verify: LDH/ATF4 up and rescue by LDH lowering in WWOX-null human neurons
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured (fly); relation=genetic epistasis in fly; transfer to human=inferred; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Only direct neural in vivo dissection; genetic rescue
unfavourable_or_alternative: Different species and context; PDH not measured; Abeta42 sensitisation
discriminating_experiment: Isogenic human neurons: LDHA/B, ATF4 panel, LDH knockdown arm, pyruvate:lactate flux
reasoning_pattern: A rescue node found by epistasis in a fly model of a neighbouring disease is proposed as the human target

observation: DCA reactivates PDH; neuropathy in MELAS RCT; tolerated in congenital lactic acidosis; PDK1 switch cytoprotective
relation_hypothesised: PDK inhibition helps only if a PDK-driven PDH block with residual capacity exists; otherwise ineffective or harmful
context: MELAS patients, congenital lactic acidosis, hypoxic cells; WWOX-DEE untested
benefit_to_verify: DCA-reversible PDH block present in WWOX-null neurons without added ROS or toxicity
unfavourable_or_alternative: Neuropathy 17/19; loss of anti-ROS adaptation; wrong node under Model B
discriminating_experiment: E1a Ser293-P and PDH activity then DCA/PDK knockdown rescue in neurons
reasoning_pattern: A drug's harm and benefit profile from other diseases is conditioned on a mechanistic prerequisite not shown in the target disease

observation: KD is first-line in genuine PDCD, bypassing PDH via ketone acetyl-CoA, lowers lactate and seizures
relation_hypothesised: If a neural pyruvate-oxidation defect existed in WWOX-DEE, KD would bypass it
benefit_to_verify: Rescue of neuronal viability/function by BHB in WWOX-null neurons
favourable_reason: No residual PDH needed; no DCA neuropathy; KD established adjunct in drug-resistant epilepsy
unfavourable_or_alternative: Possible benefit under Model B only speculative; limited if fixed ETC defect
discriminating_experiment: BHB supplementation arm in isogenic neurons
reasoning_pattern: Therapy effective in a clinically defined neighbouring disorder is transferred to the target if the same biochemical lesion is shown

observation: Human SH-SY5Y neurons under high glucose: WWOX activation drives mitochondrial injury; Zfra1-31 inhibition restores homeostasis
relation_hypothesised: WWOX-mitochondria effect in neurons is opposite in sign to the cancer model
benefit_to_verify: Direction of WWOX effect on neuronal mitochondria and PDH in a developmental null
unfavourable_or_alternative: Stress paradigm, activation not loss; conflicts with loss-of-function disease and gene replacement
discriminating_experiment: Isogenic WWOX-null versus control neurons under matched stress
reasoning_pattern: A counter-direction observation in a different cell context bounds transfer of a mechanism

observation: Lactate is multi-sourced; no direct neural PDH measurement exists
relation_hypothesised: Decisive assay: compartment-resolved PDH activity, E1a-P, PDK/LDH/ATF4 and 13C flux in isogenic human neurons/organoids
context: iPSC-derived cortical neurons/organoids with astrocyte separation
benefit_to_verify: Whether PDH flux is reduced and which node is rate-limiting and druggable
unfavourable_or_alternative: Co-culture or sorting may perturb metabolism (not stated by report)
discriminating_experiment: The assay itself, with compartmental pyruvate:lactate ratio and Seahorse OCR/ECAR
reasoning_pattern: When a bulk readout is non-specific, resolve by compartment and trace flux rather than infer from the surrogate

observation: Competing models A and B, plus downstream bypass
relation_hypothesised: Rescue arms: DCA/PDK knockdown, LDH inhibition/knockdown, BHB; the rescuing arm names the actionable node
possible_action: DCA, LDH inhibition, BHB in vitro
